sections.name: architecture
sections.value: Doctrine: .agents/skills/pij-team/TENETS.md; repo instantiation per docs/rules-idioms-architecture/fs3-architecture.md (binding). Primary input: scratch/agentic-query-poc/VERDICT.md (the POC is evidence FOR this packet, never a substitute). DECISION (ruled, from the POC survey): HAND-ROLLED loop, no agent-framework dependency — every surveyed crate is weakest at our Entra-bearer + deployment-URL posture, which crates/providers' AzureCredential/token-cache/retry machinery already owns. PLACEMENT: chat/tool-call provider surface in crates/providers (its own module, e.g. chat/ — 005 is landing conversation_sources in this crate concurrently, keep disjoint and expect a rebase); [agent] config port ADDITIVE in fs3_core config (chat deployment selection + loop bounds: max_iterations, token budget) plus the bounded loop service in core behind an injected provider trait (the LOOP is pure orchestration — testable with a mock provider, no live Azure in CI); daemon endpoint SYNC-FIRST (ruled): one POST running the bounded loop in-request — async-job + progress-stream is the NAMED PROMOTION deferred until 007's event wire lands; `flowspace3 ask` verb in crates/cli emitting a NEW envelope (existing envelope bytes untouched — agent contract). Tools exposed to the loop are IN-PROCESS query-service calls (search, get, docs list), never CLI shell-outs. AUTH: no coupling to w-daemon-auth — its middleware covers the whole router automatically, whichever PR merges second inherits the other. QUESTION-SHAPE HINT (Jordan-ruled, moved here from 006 u-c): the search envelope's question-shape hint ships IN THIS PACKET so it lands with the verb it advertises — predicate + wording live in this packet's own module, called from ONE minimal additive call at the ACTUAL hint site — the handler at crates/daemon/src/http.rs (~280-293) / crate::scope::steer — NOT search.rs, which holds no hint code (flea recon, verified; fence amended 2026-08-28). 006 u-c's weak-match hint lands at the same site: later merger rebases and re-verifies. GROUNDING BAR (ruled at POC): if the loop cannot find evidence via its tools it says so — it never answers from model memory. Secrets are never printed to files, logs, or envelopes.

value.rationale: ORIGINAL: solo — single-coder packet (~500 lines per the POC estimate) with one seat (pij-xerothermic-flea) carrying full POC context. AMENDED: Jordan directed a fan-out mid-run and that direction outranks this packet; prime accepted the deviation. Three DISJOINT leaf units run as omp coder seats owned by pij-xerothermic-flea, each fenced to non-overlapping files: (A) pij-impressed-krill — the additive [agent] config port (crates/core/src/config.rs + docs/reference/configuration.md); (B) pij-strong-narwhal — the chat/tool-call provider surface (new crates/providers/src/chat.rs, lib.rs exports, the four APPROVED pub(crate) keywords in azure_openai.rs, tests/chat_stub.rs), covering BOTH auth paths (Entra AND api_key_env — the product is not Entra-only); (C) pij-usual-lungfish — the question-shape hint (new crates/daemon/src/ask_hint.rs + ONE additive line at the real hint site in http.rs). The COUPLED SPINE stays with pij-xerothermic-flea and is not fanned out: the ChatProvider port trait and the ports/lib doctrine update, the bounded loop service, the testkit fake, the daemon endpoint, the CLI ask verb, docs/services/ask.md, and ALL gating and committing — coders never commit and never run harness checks. Known sequencing collision, owned deliberately: unit C and the spine's endpoint registration both touch http.rs, so the spine waits for C before integrating. MODEL DEVIATION recorded per prime: the ruled coder default is gpt-5.6-sol-fast-1M; these three spawned on base gpt-5.6-sol-fast (400K context), accepted for these micro-fenced units and not respawned. ENVIRONMENT FINDING: rust-analyzer is absent on this host (the ~/.cargo/bin symlink points at a removed rustup and Homebrew's rust does not ship it), so the LSP-first ruling could not be honoured until it was installed — logged as friction, not routed around silently.

value.name: agentic ask verb
value.paths: crates/providers chat module (new); fs3_core [agent] config port + loop service (new module); daemon ask endpoint registration + ONE additive hint call at the real hint site (crates/daemon/src/http.rs / crate::scope::steer); crates/cli ask verb; docs/services/ask.md; allowlist rows for any new deps (expected: none beyond existing reqwest/serde)
value.responsibility: flowspace3 ask answers a direct question by running a bounded tool-loop (search/get/docs) over the index and returning a grounded, address-cited answer — or an honest not-found.
value.interface: New ask envelope (JSON, versioned like siblings); provider trait injected into the loop; [agent] config port additive.
value.test_strategy: Loop logic + tool plumbing + bad-tool-call handling against an injected MOCK provider (offline, CI-safe); envelope shape tests; question-shape hint predicate tests; live Azure demo is a FIRST-LIGHT transcript in the done report, not CI.
value.note: Sync endpoint first; async-job promotion + progress stream named as follow-up, deferred to post-007.

Worktree /Users/jordanknight/substrate/flowspace/fs3-agentic-query, branch w-agentic-query off main. ABSOLUTE PATHS always (DL-007/008); CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0; no docker compose up (shared db 5433); rustc-LLVM IO failure = disk; Avail figure in reports; prove-in-tree evidence in the done report.

value.steps: Rebase onto main when 005 (crates/providers) and 006 (search.rs) merge; re-run gate + re-verify the hint line after each rebase. First light: live transcript of ask answering the watcher question grounded+cited, plus the honesty case (out-of-index question refused with citations for what IS there), plus the search envelope showing the question-shape hint.
value.integration_proof: First-light transcript + harness checks green on the rebased branch + byte-goldens from 007 untouched if present on main by then.

value.when: after first light, before the PR is marked ready
value.inputs: impl-guide + full diff; priority: grounding honesty (no model-memory answers), loop bounds enforcement (iteration/token caps, bad-tool-call handling), secret hygiene, envelope stability of existing verbs, config-port additivity

value.text: Providers-crate collision with 005 — retired by module disjointness + rebase-and-regate at composition.
search.rs collision with 006 u-c — retired by one-line additive call into this packet's own module + rebase after 006.
Confabulated answers — retired by the grounding bar + the honesty case in first light + reviewer priority.
Unbounded loop cost — retired by config-owned iteration/token caps with tested enforcement.
Luna param drift (max_completion_tokens vs max_tokens, POC pain list) — retired by the provider module owning param mapping with a test.
